messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: High error rate observed for tenant 'OrchidCo' on their Private VPC (ingress/egress). Affected path: TLS handshake failures at NLB -> backend. Severity: P2. Pager: alex (oncall).

alex (oncall): Seeing spikes ~12:10 UTC. 5xx from our side translating to TLS handshake errors. Initial guess: SNI not forwarded or mTLS mismatch. @nyla can you pull NLB logs? :eyes: 

nyla (sre): Pulling logs. Quick check shows lots of `tls_alert` entries from the NLB targets around 12:09-12:12. Backend app returns `421 TLS_REQUIRED` in logs (we use a middleware to enforce mTLS for OrchidCo).

jamie (netops): OrchidCo uses SNI-based routing to their tenant cluster, plus we have an outbound TLS inspector on the egress path for that VPC. Possible that the inspector is stripping SNI or rewritting TLS. Pulling inspector logs now.

security-bot: Noted. Policy enforcement active for that VPC: `tenant:orchidco -> require mTLS client cert + sni contains orchard.orchidco.net`.

sofia (customer-ops): OrchidCo ops reported failed requests beginning at 12:08, users seeing 502s. They haven't rotated any certs. They're on Dedicated pool 3. Reached out to confirm no changes on their side.

nyla (sre): Inspector logs show `tls_proxy: client_hello missing_sni: true` for ~60% of flows to that tenant during the window. Hypothesis: a recent haproxy sidecar in Dedicated pool 3 started doing TLS termination and re-initiating TLS without SNI.

alex (oncall): Can we confirm which hosts in pool 3 show the new sidecar? Querying instances.

jamie (netops): `aws ec2 describe-instances --filters Name=tag:pool,Values=dedicated-3 Name=tag:service,Values=sidecar` -> hostnames: d3-svc-12,d3-svc-14,d3-svc-19. d3-svc-14 shows a new container image `haproxy:2.6.0-custom` deployed at 11:50 UTC.

nyla (sre): Correlate: errors start 12:08, steady increase. d3-svc-14 spike in errors. Looks like that sidecar rewrite removed SNI on re-init, causing backend mTLS check to fail.

ops-lead: Immediate mitigation options: 1) roll sidecar back on d3-svc-14, 2) add temporary ingress rule to route OrchidCo traffic to an alternate pool without the sidecar, 3) relax mTLS check (bad). Recommend 1 + 2 as safety net.

alex (oncall): I'll attempt rollback on d3-svc-14 now. Notify OrchidCo of mitigation and possible brief hiccup. @sofia send a quick status.

sofia (customer-ops): Messaging OrchidCo: "We're investigating TLS failures; mitigation in progress. May see brief retries. Will update in 15m."

jamie (netops): Rolling back container image on d3-svc-14: `kubectl -n tenant-dedicated-3 set image deploy/sidecar sidecar=haproxy:2.5.8 --record`

incident-bot: Deploy rollback triggered by alex (oncall) at 12:22 UTC. CI/CD job id: deploy-7782.

nyla (sre): After rollback, I still see some failed handshakes but dropping. 12:26 UTC counts down from 120/s -> 18/s. Backend `421 TLS_REQUIRED` events down accordingly.

alex (oncall): Keep monitoring. Jamie, can you put a weighted DNS shift to move OrchidCo hostnames to fallback pool (dedicated-2) as safety? We'll do small weight then cut if rollback incomplete.

jamie (netops): Initiating DNS weighted shift: `route53 change-resource-record-sets --change-batch file://shift-orchidco.json` -> applied weight 20% to dedicated-2 at 12:28 UTC.

nyla (sre): Post-shift metrics: error rate for OrchidCo reduced to baseline within 6 minutes. d3-svc-14 no longer showing high tls_proxy missing_sni.

sofia (customer-ops): OrchidCo confirms traffic normalizing. Thanks. They still want a postmortem and root cause.

security-bot: Note: Temporary DNS shift performed. No security policy relaxed. Need to validate whether the new haproxy image intentionally removed `proxy_protocol`/SNI passthrough config.

ops-lead: Action items for post-incident: 1) Audit sidecar image rollouts to dedicated pools (who approved 2.6.0-custom), 2) Add canary rollout gating for sidecar changes on tenant pools with SNI/mTLS enforcement, 3) Add healthcheck that validates SNI passthrough for affected tenants, 4) Customer postmortem and RCA.

nyla (sre): I'll collect logs and provide timeline + script to detect `client_hello missing_sni` in TLS inspector logs. Will include steps we used to rollback and DNS shift.

alex (oncall): Handoff to next oncall at 12:40 UTC. Checklist: confirm rollback persisted, confirm DNS has fully propagated, validate OrchidCo monitoring.

incident-bot: Handoff: alex (oncall) -> nyla (sre) at 12:40 UTC. Pager cleared for alex.

nyla (sre): Taking post-incident ownership. I'll schedule a 1hr postmortem doc and invite jamie, ops-lead, sofia, and security.

sofia (customer-ops): I'll coordinate the customer SVC call and draft communication. OrchidCo requested we include mitigation timeline and cert validation checklist.

ops-lead: Temporary followups before closure: 1) block future auto-deploys of `haproxy:2.6.0-custom` to dedicated-* pools until canary passes; 2) add k8s admission webhook to prevent sidecar image without SNI config in tenant pools.

nyla (sre): Confirmed last TLS errors resolved. Marking incident as mitigated at 12:38 UTC. I'll update final notes to the incident channel once RCA doc ready.

alex (oncall): Thanks team. Good coordination.

security-bot: Reminder: open a security review ticket for the sidecar image if it modifies TLS behavior.

sofia (customer-ops): OrchidCo: "Thank you, traffic restored. We'll review certs and report back." :thumbsup:

ops-lead: Closing out channel - transfer artifacts to postmortems folder and tag with `orchidco-vpc-sni-mtls`.
